To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
e business models are composed of the four main pillars: Product Innovation, Infrastructure, Customer Relationship and Finance.

the e Business Model Ontologies is an ontology for modeling e business models that is based on the concept of the business system and is composed of four pillars: Product Innovation, Infrastructure management, Customer Relationship and Finance.

a business model is a description of the logic of a business system for creating value for a company and that the e Business Model Ontolgy is a rigorous definition of the issues and their interdependences that are relevant for creating value in a company's Internet business.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following questions: (i) What are the key elements in a business model? (ii) How can we describe these elements in an ontology that is suitable for e business? (iii) How can this ontology be used to model e business?
the development of an e business model ontology that is a rigorous, formal, and comprehensive definition of e business issues and interdependencies in a business model.

the development of an ontology that will allow us to describe, analyze and compare the different business models of different e business firms, and to provide a framework for understanding and evaluating the e business model of any firm, regardless of its industry, size or location.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
a business model is a conceptual tool that contains a set of elements and their relationships and allows expression of the business logic of a particular firm.
the e Business Model Ontolgy is an ontology that provides an abstract, rigorous and generic description of the e business logic of an organization.

a business model is a description of the value a company offers to one or several segments of customers and of the architecture of the firm and its network of partners for creating, marketing and delivering this value and relationship capital, to generate profitable and sustainable revenue streams.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a generic ontology of the business issues that are relevant to e Business.
we are proposing an e Business Model Ontological Framework for modeling e Business.
the e Business Model Ontologies provides a rigorous definition of e business issues and interdependencies in a firm's business model.
The main takeaway from our work is that
e Business Model Ontologies are a useful and rigorous way to describe and analyze the e business issues of a company.

e Business Models are not only about technology and the Internet, but they are about the business logic of companies in the Internet era, and they are about the way that business logic is affected by the new opportunities and challenges of the Internet era.
e business models are a powerful way to understand, communicate and change a company's business.
